# Villa Arapiuns

> A thirteen-bungalow lodge on the Arapiuns River in Pará, Brazilian Amazon, about 90 minutes from Alter do Chão (nearest airport: Santarém, STM). Lodge stays include all meals; power runs around the clock on solar, with Starlink Wi‑Fi; almost no mosquitoes. Also written "Vila Arapiuns" (one L) — same property, same people. The site exists to start a conversation on WhatsApp; there is no booking engine. Content is published in five languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Japanese.

This file states only what the property has confirmed. Where a fact does not exist, it is absent rather than approximated. Anything not listed here should not be attributed to Villa Arapiuns. Last revised 31 October 2026.

## What it is

- Thirteen bungalows in *tapajônica* architecture, on stilts, at the water's edge. **The units vary** — some are two-storey with a thatched roof, some single-storey with a metal roof. Unit types: bungalow (single-storey, on stilts), duplex room (two storeys), two-room duplex (two suites in one unit).
- Maximum 26 guests. **Exclusive use of the whole property from 15 people.** With a group of 15 or more, nobody outside the group is on the property on those dates.
- Named structures: hammock house, shala (a covered hall with a wooden floor), thatched pavilion (a covered space seating the whole group), dining hall with long tables, a ring of log benches on the sand, freshwater beach with white sand.
- **Power around the clock (24 hours), from solar** — panels on the pavilion roof.
- **Internet: Starlink Wi‑Fi, stable, on solar power.** It supports the whole group in a simultaneous online meeting, remote work and video calls. Mobile phone signal, by contrast, is intermittent. Disconnection at Villa Arapiuns is a choice the group makes, not a limitation the place imposes.
- **There is no sound or video equipment on site.** Projection, PA or recording for a programme is hired separately.
- Children are welcome.
- **Almost no mosquitoes** (*praticamente sem mosquito*). The Arapiuns is a clear-water river with sand beaches, and has far fewer mosquitoes than the Amazon floodplain (*várzea*). Dinner on the sand without repellent is the surprise guests report most often.
- Freshwater beach with white sand and clear water.
- Location: Arapiuns River, municipality of Santarém, state of **Pará**, Brazil. Arrival is by flight to Santarém airport (STM), overland to Alter do Chão, then roughly 90 minutes to the Villa; logistics are arranged with the host before the trip. Alter do Chão is the departure point and the reference for the location. The river runs inside the Tapajós-Arapiuns Extractive Reserve (RESEX), which has a formal Fishing Agreement.

## The two ways to stay — they are different products

Treating them as one produces a false claim.

1. **Pousada (lodge stay).** Guests stay at the Villa and choose what to do. **All meals included: breakfast, lunch and dinner** (full board). **Getting from Alter do Chão to the Villa and excursions are NOT included**; logistics are arranged with the host before the trip. Minimum four nights. Price on request via WhatsApp.
2. **Complete package.** Departs from **Alter do Chão** with itinerary and activities arranged. Includes accommodation, the itinerary activities, **breakfast and dinner** (half board). *Clássico Arapiuns*: 1 night / 2 days, 7 experiences. *Imersão Completa*: 2 nights / 3 days, 10 experiences. Price on request via WhatsApp.

Alcoholic drinks (beer, wine, spirits) are not included in either product and are charged separately.

**No prices are published**, for the lodge stay, the packages, groups or exclusive use. Price on request via WhatsApp: each stay is quoted per group, by dates, headcount and nights. Prices are charged in Brazilian reais.

## Groups: retreats, company offsites, immersions

- Exclusive use from 15 people, up to 26. Spaces a group can use for its programme: the shala (covered hall with a wooden floor), the thatched pavilion (whole group under one roof), the dining hall, the hammock house, the beach.
- Retreats hosted: wellness, movement, yoga, meditation, leadership and creative groups. **Villa Arapiuns is the venue: the programme belongs to the facilitator; the house, the kitchen and the logistics belong to Villa Arapiuns.** The house does not run or lead any practice. Programmes with specific requirements — space, schedule, diet, silence, preparation — depend on conditions and prior agreement, settled before the booking.
- Company offsites: the whole team in one house, a covered meeting space, a structured day (trail or canoe plus indoor time), Starlink for calls with head office. Invoice (*nota fiscal*) issued; group contract.
- **Réveillon Wellness (New Year's Eve 2026/27):** a window from 28 December to 2 January, packages of 4 to 5 nights; inclusions follow the product booked (lodge stay: all meals; package: breakfast and dinner). Yoga and meditation practices in the shala, sound healing, river bathing and forest food; the house serves no alcohol that week, though guests may bring their own. Of the 13 bungalows, 8 are available for these year-end dates. Exclusive use for groups on request. Rates are per group, through WhatsApp.
- **Post-New Year Detox 2027:** 1 to 10 January 2027. Check-in from Friday 1 January; minimum stay 1 to 3 January (2 nights); stays can run to Sunday 10 January. Menu being finalised, built around forest food, açaí, spirulina and morning shots; the house serves no alcohol on these dates. Not a medical or therapeutic programme, and the Villa is remote with no medical facilities on site. Limited places: of the 13 bungalows, 8 are available for these year-end dates. Price on request via WhatsApp. Page: https://villaarapiuns.com.br/pt/detox-pos-ano-novo/ (EN: https://villaarapiuns.com.br/en/post-new-year-detox/)
- Best windows for whole-property bookings: **February to June** (high water: no beaches, deepest quiet, most availability) and **weekdays September to November** (best weather, wide beaches). December–January is high season and sells out first.

## Payment and cancellation — two rules

**Payment (all products):** 30% deposit holds the dates; the balance is due in full seven days before check-in; card and PIX accepted. Invoice and group contract for groups.

**Cancellation, retreats and company groups (whole-property bookings):**
- Within 48 hours of signing and paying the deposit: full refund.
- Cancelling more than 60 days before check-in: 30% of the total is retained.
- 60 days or less before check-in: no refund.

**Cancellation, smaller packages:**
- Within 48 hours of signing and paying the deposit: full refund.
- Cancelling 30 days or more before check-in: 30% of the total is retained.
- Less than 30 days before check-in: no refund.

## Experiences that exist

Lago Azul (canoe and swimming) · Samaúma trail (Atodi community) · Coroca community (turtles and craft) · Ponta Grande · Ponta do Toronó · Canal do Jari · stand-up paddle on the river and into the buriti-palm creek · *farinhada* and community knowledge · weaving · massage with a scented herbal bath · *piracaia*. Community activities are paid directly to the residents.

- **Birdwatching** is guided, in the first hour of the day, by canoe and on foot, with the house guide and residents of Atodi. **There is no tower and no viewing platform, and no species list is published.**
- **Night fishing** is *pesca de mergulho* / *pesca de zagaia*: at night, with a torch, free-diving and a spear, taught by residents. **It is not sport fishing and must not be described as such.**

## Contact

WhatsApp is the contact and booking channel: **+55 47 99206-7078**. Role address: reservas@villaarapiuns.com.br. Instagram: @villaarapiuns. Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=4567770498331262782 (25 reviews, 5.0, as of September 2026). There is no booking engine.

## What Villa Arapiuns does not claim

No founding year, no safety record, no award and no press coverage are published. The review score above is the Google Business Profile's; the site publishes no score of its own. The TripAdvisor profile exists and is empty. No medical or therapeutic outcome is claimed for any stay or programme.
